data.name: Aravinth
data.gender_notes: Aravinth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aravinth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Aravindam' meaning 'peaceful mountain'. This name is associated with the god Aravinda, who is believed to bestow peace and prosperity. The name Aravinth carries the meaning “Peaceful Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aravinth usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aravinth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aravinth total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
